sources.source_date: 2018-10-14 filename; exact capture date not independently confirmed

sources.uncertainty: Low-resolution partial oblique exterior; no dimensioned plans or surveyed elevations found.

sources.role: independent exterior photo and identity cross-check
sources.provider: The Purdue Exponent, issue dated Aug. 17-18, 2017
sources.feature_identifier: 2017-08-17 issue, printed page 19, ad for The Baptist Student Foundation at Purdue, 200 N Russell St
sources.method: Photo printed with address and organization name; supports brick exterior, gabled principal roof, entry canopy, and apparent multiple levels.
sources.uncertainty: Small monochrome halftone ad; exact window count, roof pitch, and height cannot be measured.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office / Polis Center at IUPUI; Indiana Statewide LiDAR Derived Building Footprints layer
sources.method: Queried polygons within 80 m of manifest placement. Selected 441814: source polygon bbox center is within 0.313 m of prior massing bbox center; its polygon area centroid is 1.611 m from that center because the southern stem shifts the centroid. It has an 8-vertex T-shaped outline plus a closing coordinate. Vertices were inverse-projected then transformed to repository local XY. No scale fitting applied.
sources.uncertainty: Automated LiDAR footprint extraction, published as-is; not a survey. Service area/perimeter use map-plane units, while local metrics apply the project local conversion.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana 2023 Imagery ImageServer
sources.feature_identifier: Exported 1400x1400 JPG, Web Mercator bbox around feature centroid; 2023 county orthophoto
sources.crs: EPSG:3857 export bbox; image has no embedded CRS; export parameters and service metadata preserved beside it
sources.method: Plan-view comparison: T-shaped footprint aligns with T-shaped roof, with north crossbar and southern projecting wing; roof edge and ridge details are visually estimated.
sources.uncertainty: Orthophoto cannot verify wall height, floors, facade, or entrance.

sources.provider: Purdue University Libraries, Campus Buildings Historic Database / Purdue Campus GIS
sources.feature_identifier: Purdue campus GIS search within 150 m; legacy campus layer did not return this current off-campus foundation; nearby historic features saved as context only
sources.source_date: campus GIS time extent through 2015; no match for current Baptist Student Foundation
sources.method: Recorded negative search result to avoid confusing a historic Baptist Church record elsewhere with this building.
sources.uncertainty: The Found is adjacent to but outside the historic campus layer coverage; current organization address and Exponent ad support identity.

geometry_and_design.source_date: 2018 lidar collection; statewide dataset publication date 2022-08-08
geometry_and_design.local_frame: EPSG:3857 vertices inverse-projected to geographic, then approximate Purdue campus local XY per modular/AGENTS.md: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274 radians), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040

revision.structural_footprint: Feature 441814 vertex ring after inverse Web Mercator and local-frame transform; no fit-to-bounds scaling applied.

geometry_and_design.uncertainty: The Indiana statewide layer is LiDAR-derived and reference-grade only, not a survey. SHAPE__Area/Length are service properties in EPSG:3857 map units; local-plan metrics above use the repository approximate ground conversion. Height/story count, gable pitch, facade rhythm, and entrance location are estimates based on 2017 exterior photo and 2023 orthophoto, not measured.

remaining_uncertainty: No published measured heights or floor plans located.
Exact heights, facade windows, main entrance position, roof pitch, and color values are estimates from dated images.
The 2018 LiDAR footprint is automated; no cadastral or boundary survey was available.
